zh.title: FAA宣布世足賽反無人機行動成果 逾700架無人機被查扣
zh.summary: 美國運輸部長肖恩·杜菲宣布，聯邦、州和地方合作夥伴在2026年國際足聯世界盃期間實施了美國歷史上最全面的空域安全和無人機緩解行動，查獲超過700架無人機，確保數百萬球迷的安全。
body: 美國聯邦航空總署宣布，2026年國際足聯世界盃期間的反無人機行動成功保障數百萬球迷安全，行動中查扣超過700架無人機。
運輸部長肖恩·杜菲表示，聯邦、州及地方合作夥伴執行了美國歷史上最全面的空域安全與無人機緩解行動，展現前所未有的多機關協調保護賽事空域。

en.title: FAA Announces Successful Counter-Drone Efforts at FIFA World Cup 2026, Over 700 Drones Seized
en.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration has announced that the counter-drone efforts undertaken during the FIFA World Cup 2026 were successful in keeping millions of fans safe, with more than 700 drones seized during the tournament. According to Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy, federal, state, and local partners carried out the most comprehensive airspace security and drone mitigation effort in the history of the United States, demonstrating an unprecedented level of coordination to protect the event.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration announced that counter-drone efforts during the FIFA World Cup 2026 were successful in keeping millions of fans safe, with more than 700 drones seized during the tournament.

Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy stated that federal, state, and local partners carried out the most comprehensive airspace security and drone mitigation effort in United States history during the World Cup, marking an unprecedented coordinated operation to protect the event's airspace.
